question: Number of completed orders
oracle_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status='completed'

question: What is total revenue from completed orders?
oracle_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price),2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='completed'

question: Count orders by status
oracle_sql: SELECT status,COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status

question: Count customers by region
oracle_sql: SELECT region,COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY region

question: How many orders were cancelled?
oracle_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status='cancelled'

question: How much completed-order revenue belongs to each product category?
oracle_sql: SELECT p.category,ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price),2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY p.category

question: Completed revenue by customer region
oracle_sql: SELECT c.region,ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price),2) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY c.region

question: Count completed orders by month
oracle_sql: SELECT substr(order_date,1,7),COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status='completed' GROUP BY substr(order_date,1,7)

question: Count completed orders placed by enterprise customers
oracle_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE o.status='completed' AND c.segment='enterprise'

question: Number of distinct customers with a completed purchase
oracle_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders WHERE status='completed'

question: What was revenue from completed orders in March 2026?
oracle_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price),2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id=oi.order_id WHERE o.status='completed' AND o.order_date >= '2026-03-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-04-01'

question: Count products by category
oracle_sql: SELECT category,COUNT(*) FROM products GROUP BY category

question: Top three products by units sold on completed orders
oracle_sql: SELECT oi.product_id,SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY oi.product_id ORDER BY units DESC,oi.product_id LIMIT 3

question: Average quantity per line item for completed orders
oracle_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(oi.quantity),2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='completed'

question: Count completed orders with more than one line item
oracle_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT o.order_id FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY o.order_id HAVING COUNT(*)>1)

question: Total units ordered by product category, excluding cancelled orders
oracle_sql: SELECT p.category,SUM(oi.quantity) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id=oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id=p.product_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY p.category

question: Count resolved tickets
oracle_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tickets WHERE state='resolved'

question: Count tickets by state
oracle_sql: SELECT state,COUNT(*) FROM tickets GROUP BY state

question: Count tickets by priority
oracle_sql: SELECT priority,COUNT(*) FROM tickets GROUP BY priority

question: Total minutes logged
oracle_sql: SELECT SUM(minutes) FROM worklogs

question: Count agents per team
oracle_sql: SELECT team,COUNT(*) FROM agents GROUP BY team

question: Average worklog duration
oracle_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(minutes),2) FROM worklogs

question: Minutes worked on resolved tickets
oracle_sql: SELECT SUM(w.minutes) FROM worklogs w JOIN tickets t ON t.ticket_id=w.ticket_id WHERE t.state='resolved'

question: Resolved tickets by agent team
oracle_sql: SELECT a.team,COUNT(*) FROM tickets t JOIN agents a ON t.agent_id=a.agent_id WHERE t.state='resolved' GROUP BY a.team

question: Billable minutes by priority
oracle_sql: SELECT t.priority,SUM(w.minutes) FROM tickets t JOIN worklogs w ON t.ticket_id=w.ticket_id WHERE w.billable=1 GROUP BY t.priority

question: Count high-priority open tickets
oracle_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tickets WHERE priority='high' AND state='open'
